title: Vegan Polish Oat Gratin
description: A hearty vegan gratin made with oats, perfect for a chilly evening. This dish is a twist on classic Polish cuisine.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the mushroom duxelles until fragrant.
Add the seitan to the skillet and cook until browned.
In a separate pot, bring the vegetable broth to a simmer.
Add the oats to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of the oat mixture.
Top the oat layer with the seitan and mushroom mixture.
Sprinkle the nutritional yeast and gratin cheese alternative over the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
Garnish with fresh thyme and serve hot.
